# Midnight Grid (starter theme)

A second sample theme. It uses the same content and the same core components as the default theme, but a different
arrangement: dark surfaces, a three-column card grid on the homepage, and a centered header.

Use it as a starting point for your own theme. Copy the folder, change `id`, `name` and `version`, edit the tokens and
CSS, then pack it as a ZIP. See `docs/theme-development.md`.
